title: Paloma and the Autopsy
author: W. M. Okafor
blurb: Emrys Okafor, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
